steps.text: Anchor a tower to terrain with the strongest supports available, then place a piece at least 49 metres above that terrain.

achievements.summary: Raise a very tall structure.

steps.text: Climb a high Deep North or Mountain peak and place a piece when the world-altitude tracker is at least 432 metres; extend upward with properly supported pieces if needed.

achievements.summary: Place a build piece at or above 432 metres world altitude.

steps.text: Before starting the 30-day Survivor streak, record enemy, fall, drowning, burning, freezing, poison, smoke, world-edge, tree/log, ballista, stalactite, catapult, Ashlands-ocean, Obliterator, drawbridge, and Ashlands-lava deaths; verify each row in the tracker after respawning.

For the unusual entries, first bank gear and lower health. Load a Ballista and leave it in Everything mode so it targets players, then stand in its firing arc. In a Frost Cave, stand directly under a hanging stalactite and trigger its fall. For Catapult credit, have a helper fire a loaded Catapult at your marked position (or use a close obstacle and move into the impact point solo). Swim in the hot Ashlands ocean for ocean credit, stand in Ashlands lava for lava credit, pull an Obliterator lever and remain beside it through the delayed lightning area, and operate a Timberwood Drawbridge before moving into its closing path. A helper is optional for timing; the condition itself has no multiplayer requirement.

achievements.summary: Die in every way possible.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on any difficulty.

steps.text: On one character, defeat Eikthyr, The Elder, Bonemass, Moder, Yagluth, The Queen, Fader, and Kall Fimbulbringer on any allowed difficulty.

achievements.summary: Defeat all bosses on any difficulty.

steps.text: Defeat Brenna in a Black Forest Smouldering Tomb, Geirrhafa in a Mountain Howling Cavern, Zil and Thungr in the Plains Sealed Tower, and Lord Reto in his Ashlands tomb; the paired Zil and Thungr encounter supplies two distinct kill conditions.

achievements.summary: Defeat all minibosses.

steps.text: Start or load any world and let the character finish spawning once after version 1.0 is installed.

achievements.summary: Spawn into a world for the first time after installing version 1.0.

steps.text: Let the character die once from any cause, preferably before starting the 30-day no-death streak.

achievements.summary: Die once from any cause.

steps.text: At Eikthyr's Meadows altar, offer 2 Deer Trophies and defeat Eikthyr.

achievements.summary: Offer 2 Deer Trophies at Eikthyr's Meadows altar and defeat Eikthyr.

steps.text: At The Elder's Black Forest altar, burn 3 Ancient Seeds and defeat The Elder.

achievements.summary: Burn 3 Ancient Seeds at The Elder's Black Forest altar and defeat The Elder.

steps.text: At Bonemass's Swamp altar, offer 10 Withered Bones and defeat Bonemass.

achievements.summary: Offer 10 Withered Bones at Bonemass's Swamp altar and defeat Bonemass.

steps.text: Carry 3 Dragon Eggs to Moder's Mountain altar, offer them, and defeat Moder.

achievements.summary: Offer 3 Dragon Eggs at Moder's Mountain altar and defeat Moder.

steps.text: Bring 5 Fuling Totems to Yagluth's Plains altar, offer them, and defeat Yagluth.

achievements.summary: Offer 5 Fuling Totems at Yagluth's Plains altar and defeat Yagluth.

steps.text: Assemble a Sealbreaker, open an Infested Citadel in the Mistlands, and defeat The Queen; the first fight requires no sacrifice.

achievements.summary: Assemble a Sealbreaker, open an Infested Citadel in the Mistlands, and defeat The Queen.

steps.text: Loot 9 Bell Fragments from Charred Fortresses, craft 3 Bells, offer them at Fader's Ashlands altar, and defeat Fader.

achievements.summary: Loot 9 Bell Fragments, craft 3 Bells, offer them at Fader's Ashlands altar, and defeat Fader.

steps.text: Search large two-storey Deep North village ruins for pits into Hidden Tunnels, recover a mould, make an Intricate Key, and use it to unlock Morkhalla.
Complete the resulting Jotun invasion for Malicious Blood. Repeat the Hidden Tunnel–key–Morkhalla cycle three times, then offer 3 Malicious Blood at the Strange Bowl and defeat Kall Fimbulbringer.

achievements.summary: Complete the Hidden Tunnel and Morkhalla cycle three times, offer 3 Malicious Blood at the Strange Bowl, and defeat Kall Fimbulbringer.

steps.text: Place an Obliterator in a safe area, reduce health, activate it, and remain close enough for the lightning blast to kill you.

achievements.summary: Place an Obliterator, activate it, and stand in its lightning blast until it kills you.

steps.text: Lower health, fell a tree, and stand in the falling trunk or rolling log's path until the impact is fatal.

achievements.summary: Let a falling tree trunk or rolling log kill you.

steps.text: Let a fatal trunk or rolling-log hit from each of the ten named tree types kill you: Fir, Oak, Pine, Scorched Tree, Yggdrasil Shoot, Ancient Tree, Beech, Birch, Snow Fir, and Snow Pine.

For each named variant, chop it until the next hit will fell it, clear the downhill path, bank gear, lower health, finish the cut from the uphill side, and step into the falling trunk or roll the log onto yourself. Respawn and confirm that exact tree row before moving to the next biome.

achievements.summary: Let all ten named tree types each deliver a fatal trunk or rolling-log hit.

steps.text: Cut down 500 trees; begin immediately and upgrade axes naturally with biome progression.

achievements.summary: Cut down 500 trees.

steps.text: Cook 100 dishes; parallel cooking stations over one fire speed up bulk processing.

achievements.summary: Cook 100 dishes.

steps.text: Plant, replant, and harvest crops until 500 harvests register; obtain the Cultivator after bronze becomes available.

achievements.summary: Harvest 500 crops.

steps.text: Pick 250 berries and 250 mushrooms; Plains Cloudberries and farmable Mistlands mushrooms are efficient late sources.

achievements.summary: Pick 250 berries and 250 mushrooms.

guide.context: Use one character and the in-game tracker. Build 25253764 generates 108 unique keys, including separate base and phase-three Kall keys; complete Kall through all phases and verify both same-name rows. Hard kills also satisfy the any-difficulty list. The four Spiritcaller animals and the Skelett are your own summons: enable the PvP toggle to damage them, because player attacks otherwise skip non-enemy targets.

guide.context: The live build produces 68 unique trophy conditions; the Steam guide list carries a duplicate Draugr display name, and the live tracker de-duplicates by internal token. Use the 68-row checklist.

achievements.summary: Pick up every unique trophy in the current build-generated checklist.

steps.text: Within loaded zones, place at least 6 floors, 8 walls, 4 roofs, 1 furniture item, 1 light, and 1 storage piece.

achievements.summary: Build a house.

steps.text: Within loaded zones, place 10 Buildings, 40 Floors, 40 Walls, 20 Roofs, 10 Architecture pieces, 10 Furniture pieces, 5 Lights, and 5 Decor pieces.

achievements.summary: Build a village.

steps.text: Build several Beehives early and harvest them whenever full until 500 honey registers.

achievements.summary: Harvest 500 honey.

achievements.displayName: No Adventuring On an Empty Stomach

steps.text: Keep food buffs active during normal play and consume 500 edible items in total.

achievements.summary: Eat 500 items of food.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on normal difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Before every boss kill, set Combat Difficulty to Normal or Hard and preserve that setting through all eight fights on the same character.

achievements.summary: Defeat all bosses on normal difficulty or higher.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses on hard difficulty.

steps.text: Set Combat Difficulty to Hard before the first checklist kill and defeat all eight bosses while it remains Hard; these kills also advance Master Hunter.

achievements.summary: Defeat all bosses on hard difficulty.

steps.text: After deliberate death achievements, survive 30 consecutive in-game days; any death resets the streak.

achievements.summary: Survive for 30 consecutive days.

steps.text: In late game, build one sheltered room and combine unique comfort categories until the HUD shows 20; use a hearth, best bed, rug, banner, throne, table, item stand, lit hot tub, seasonal light, Lava Lantern, and Asksvin Skeleton as available.

achievements.summary: Reach a comfort level of 20.

steps.text: Use a disposable boat and gear, sail roughly 10,350 metres from the centre, and continue over the world edge until the condition registers.

achievements.summary: Sail a boat over the edge of the world and fall until you die.

steps.text: Equip the Wishbone from Bonemass, follow pulses to buried treasure, dig up and open 10 treasure chests.

achievements.summary: Dig up and open 10 buried treasure chests located with the Wishbone.

steps.text: Find a Leviathan in the Ocean and mine Abyssal Barnacles until it wakes and begins to sink.

achievements.summary: Mine an Abyssal Barnacle on a Leviathan until it wakes and starts to sink.

steps.text: In Ashlands Putrid Holes, find a Vegvisir that marks the first Mysterious Location; break into its Grausten ruin and take the Dyrnwyn Tip Fragment.

Upgrade the Black Forge to level 4 and craft Dyrnwyn with all three fragments.

guide.context: Place each exact runtime build-piece row once. Carry its unlock material, equip the appropriate build tool, and stand inside any named station radius. Calendar-gated pieces require Midsummer (June 1–July 6), Halloween (October 1–November 6), and Yule (December 1–January 6). Normal completion therefore spans those three windows; previously learned pieces may remain known, but do not rely on that for a fresh character.

achievements.description: Embody the spirits of the Viking, Hunter, Artisan, Master Chef, Carpenter and the Explorer.

steps.text: On one character, finish The Viking, The Hunter, The Artisan, The Master Chef, The Carpenter, and The Explorer; this mastery condition then resolves automatically.

achievements.summary: Embody the spirits of the Viking, Hunter, Artisan, Master Chef, Carpenter and the Explorer.

achievements.description: Embody the spirits of the Toughest Viking, Master Hunter, Survivor and Pathfinder.

steps.text: On one character, finish The Toughest Viking, The Master Hunter, The Survivor, and The Pathfinder; this mastery condition then resolves automatically.

achievements.summary: Embody the spirits of the Toughest Viking, Master Hunter, Survivor and Pathfinder.

steps.text: Invite a named second player, make sure both players damage the same boss, and defeat it together.

steps.text: Defeat a boss without any other player damaging it; a repeat Eikthyr kill is the quickest controlled attempt.

steps.text: Use short casts to conserve stamina and land any quality-4 fish; early-biome water is safer while learning the stamina rhythm.
